messages.template.clinic.guideFlow: In List of pages, search and select a patient under Billing Clinic to open their billing workspace in a new tab. Open Invoices & payments, then View bill for the full invoice, insurance, line totals, receipts and revision history. Edit bill changes quantities, discount, insurance authorization and notes on unpaid issued invoices. Enter a correction reason and confirm. The API recalculates using its current tariffs and retains the previous invoice snapshot. Payment history, including refunds, prevents edits. Conflicts require loading and reviewing the latest ledger before saving again. Unsaved correction values survive recoverable failures; Back to billing confirms discard.
messages.template.clinic.guideIntegration: Use the public typed workspace and adapters shown in TypeScript. The authenticated demo API reads patient CSV and writes a separate billing CSV ledger. Replace adapters to connect another application.
messages.template.clinic.guidePreferences: Uses effective tenant-locked preferences for layout, theme, fonts, density, tables, dates and number display. Ledger currency comes from the API and is not converted by a display preference.
messages.template.clinic.guideRecovery: Input remains on screen during recoverable errors. Retry reuses operation identity. Load the latest ledger after a conflict and review your retained input. Browser-close draft restoration is not provided.
messages.template.clinic.guideLimits: Fictional single-process demo: no real card processing, insurance submission, tax certification, pharmacy dispensing or accounting posting. Refunds reverse a full payment; invoices cannot be edited after issue.

messages.template.triage.guideFlow: Select a patient. Enter the complaint, observed vital signs, allergy review, manual priority and next care area. Save a draft or review and complete. Previous assessments opens saved drafts and completed history. New assessment starts empty readings.
messages.template.triage.guideIntegration: Use ClinicalTriageWorkspace with the typed triage and patient adapters shown in the TypeScript example. Authenticated API calls read patient CSV and persist assessments in a separate tenant/application/patient-scoped triage CSV.
messages.template.triage.guidePreferences: Use the numbered master-record rail to move between Complaint & safety, Vital signs and Disposition & handoff. One section is visible at a time beside the triage snapshot. Save draft and Complete triage stay in the action bar. Tabs and wizard remain available through effective preferences. Values, choices, history and saves use the demo API; the summary reflects entered data and is not a clinical recommendation.
messages.template.triage.guideRecovery: Drafts are explicitly saved to the API and resume when reopening the patient. Unsaved input remains during recoverable errors. Retry reuses operation identity. Load latest after a conflict; a completed server record replaces stale edits and must be reassessed separately.
messages.template.triage.guideLimits: This is a fictional entry workflow, not a validated triage scale, clinical score or treatment recommendation. Priority is always assigned manually. Production protocols, clinical review, dedicated nurse permissions and retention controls belong to the integrating application.

No diagnosis suggestions, prescribing, investigation dispatch, appointment booking, billing, electronic signature or clinical decision support is performed. Clinical review and production EHR integration remain application responsibilities.

Tab counts show entered fields. Values stay when switching sections. New optional fields save through the demo API; older notes remain readable. Vitals are manually entered, and prescriptions, procedures, referrals and consent remain documentation notes rather than dispatched or signed actions.

Summary field buttons jump to the related section. Review full note displays all recorded sections without saving. The patient banner reads the latest completed triage from the demo API as reference only; open its details to review all measurements. Triage belongs to its original encounter and is not copied automatically.

messages.care.help.overview: These component-based pages reproduce the supplied standalone designs using the authenticated demo API and CSV records.
messages.care.help.emergency: Select a patient or create a temporary identity. Open the ED encounter, record triage, complete registration and care sections, then review disposition and handover before completion.
messages.care.help.inpatient: Select a patient and admission source. Record the receiving team and coverage, reserve a compatible bed, verify the patient and admit. Continue in the nursing, medical, orders, transfer and discharge tabs.
messages.care.help.consultation: Select a patient and consultation configuration. Use the section rail to complete the seven clinical sections. Save, preview and confirm before signing. Signed records accept addenda instead of edits.
messages.care.help.orders: Version 2 adds structured medication, laboratory, imaging and procedure order dialogs. All entered order details are saved by the API. Cancellation retains the original order in history.
messages.care.help.preferences: Effective theme, font scales, density, field presentation, language and date formats follow My Preferences and tenant locks. These pages do not add their own application sidebar.
messages.care.help.recovery: Save draft writes an explicit API record. Restore uses the saved-record selector. Failed requests preserve entered values; retry keeps the same operation ID. Reload after a conflict replaces unsaved edits only after confirmation.
messages.care.help.boundary: This is a reusable frontend demonstration, not a production clinical system. Payer verification, physical transfers, bed cleaning, real prescriptions and legally validated signatures require separate integrations. Do not enter real patient data.
messages.care.help.integration: Inject createCareAdapter and the effective preference host into CareWorkspace. The authenticated POST /care-pages endpoint scopes saved records by tenant, application, user and page. Definitions and synthetic patients and beds come from backend JSON and CSV files.

messages.designer.help.dependencies: For dependent dropdowns, create Country with IN|India and AE|UAE. Create State with KL|Kerala, KA|Karnataka, AZ|Abu Dhabi and DU|Dubai. In State properties choose Depends on: Country, then map KL/KA to IN and AZ/DU to AE. Or insert the API-provided Country → State example. Preview loads options from the API, disables children until a valid parent is selected, and clears all descendants on parent changes. Retry failed lookups without losing parent selections. Validate preview checks matching parent/child IDs on the demo API without saving answers. Cycles, missing parents, unmapped options and more than five dependency links are rejected. Company → Branch uses the same generic configuration. Dataset imports and multi-parent conditions are not included.
messages.designer.catalogScope: Shared within this tenant and application. Only administrators can create revisions.
messages.designer.catalogPinned: Forms use the selected revision. Saving a new catalog revision does not change existing forms.
messages.designer.catalogSaved: New revision saved. Existing form references remain unchanged.
messages.designer.catalogInvalid: Enter a name and unique options, or map every child option to a valid parent in the selected revisions.
messages.designer.catalogRefreshed: Catalog refreshed. Reopen a revision to edit its latest values; your current edits are still here.
messages.designer.help.catalog: Open Manage value sets to create option lists shared within the current tenant and application. Only administrators can save new revisions. Use Relationships to select exact parent and child set revisions and map every child option. In field settings, choose an Option source revision; dependent fields also select their parent field and a compatible Shared relationship. Existing forms remain pinned when a new revision is saved. Adopting new revisions is explicit. Refresh catalog preserves edits; after a conflict, reopen the latest revision before saving. Catalog changes do not save or replace your current form. Inline options remain supported. Limits are 50 options per set and 100 retained revisions each for sets and relationships. Production DCP integration, inactive-value policies and publication approvals remain pending.
messages.designer.catalogLimit: The catalog has reached its limit of 100 revisions for this entry type.
messages.designer.csvHelp: Upload UTF-8 CSV, map ID and label columns, then review every row. Apply replaces the option editor only; Save new revision commits the complete dataset through the API. Existing published references are unchanged.
messages.designer.csvLimit: Import 1–50 option rows. Larger datasets are not supported here.
messages.designer.csvMapping: Choose two different columns for ID and label.
messages.designer.csvRow: Use a unique nonblank ID (up to 80 characters) and a label (up to 160). Pipes and line breaks are not supported in this editor.
messages.designer.csvEncoding: Choose a valid UTF-8 CSV file.
messages.designer.rulesHelp: Rules are typed and cycle-checked. Hidden values are retained; visibility does not grant access. Calculations are recomputed by the API.
messages.designer.calculationError: Complete valid calculation inputs; division by zero is not allowed.
messages.designer.lengthError: The text length is outside the configured range.
messages.designer.formatError: The text does not match the configured format.
messages.designer.lifecycleHelp: Demo administrators preview review and publishing roles. Production separation of duties requires the host authorization/workflow adapter. Save edits before a transition.
messages.designer.runtimeHelp: Synthetic entity records from the demo API. Answers are pinned to the selected release and owner; submitted answers are read-only. This is not a production domain transaction.
messages.designer.lifecycleConflict: This form or answer is no longer editable in the requested state. Reload and review its current status.
messages.designer.commentRequired: Enter a reason for this transition.
messages.designer.bindingRequired: Choose a registered entity and trigger before review or publication.
messages.designer.datasetHelp: Upload CSV or XLSX, choose a worksheet and map text ID/label columns. Review all rows before replacing the editor. Saving creates one complete revision; old form references stay pinned.
messages.designer.datasetFile: Choose a CSV or XLSX file up to 2 MB.
messages.designer.workbookInvalid: Workbook rejected. Use a plain XLSX with at most 10 sheets, 80 columns and 1,000 data rows per sheet, without macros or external links.
messages.designer.workbookFormula: Formula cells are not allowed. Export values-only before importing.
messages.designer.workbookTimeout: Workbook parsing exceeded its time limit. Simplify the file and retry.
messages.designer.datasetBudget: The demo catalog has reached its 10,000 retained-option budget. Use the production dataset adapter for larger workloads.
messages.designer.hostError: The host DCP service rejected this operation. Review permissions, version and field errors through the host adapter.
messages.designer.integrationHelp: The host adapter must map the current Spring Boot contract, authorize records and fields, and validate domain transactions. Demo CSV persistence does not establish production integration.
messages.designer.v1.boundary: Uses the DCP v1 API contract. The Library uses a synthetic API dataset; production endpoints are supplied by the host application.
messages.designer.v1.rowUnavailable: Row permissions are unavailable. Reload before editing.
messages.designer.v1.removed: Row marked for removal; save to confirm.
messages.designer.v1.instant: ISO timestamp with an explicit offset, for example 2026-09-11T08:00:00Z.
messages.designer.v1.conflict: Reloading discards unsaved edits. After a conflict or uncertain save, compare the latest record before editing again. No save is automatically retried.
messages.designer.v1.error.MINIMUM: The value is below the minimum.
messages.designer.multiParentHelp: All parent selections must match. Changing any parent clears this field and its descendants.
messages.designer.labelFallback: Fallback: selected language → English → original label. Field IDs and values do not change.
messages.designer.compareHelp: Review changes by stable field identity before publishing. Values below are design metadata, not patient answers.
messages.designer.guide.contract.overview: Compose reusable forms with shared controls, layouts, translations and rules. Designs and published answer examples use the demo API. Backend contract runtime demonstrates the supplied DCP v1 contract separately; the visual design is not a backend Dcp.Form payload.
messages.designer.guide.contract.workflow: Add fields and sections, choose presentation and label language, and preview. Dropdowns can require up to four parents; map each child option to every parent. Import CSV/XLSX into a value set, review and save its revision. Save the design, select an owner type, review, approve and publish. Compare a saved release with the current design. Published forms load owner answers and show revision history.
messages.designer.guide.contract.validation: Preview checks required values, types, ranges, normalization, calculations and dropdown membership. Any parent change clears dependent selections. The v1 runtime previews edits with server rules, supports repeating rows, and keeps false as a valid present Boolean value. A 422 response displays validation errors and does not confirm a save. A conflict or uncertain save requires reviewing the server record; writes are not automatically retried.
messages.designer.guide.contract.access: Effective preferences and tenant locks still apply. Tenant-authored labels fall back from the selected language to English, then the original label. Shared recovery follows tenant retention and field exclusions and stores no browser-local copy. Recovery requires the same record revision and checksum. Draft Center lists DCP recovery drafts; open the designer and Backend contract runtime to review them. Masked and nonwritable v1 fields cannot be edited. Demo navigation and roles are not production field authorization.
messages.designer.guide.contract.integration: Use DcpDesignerWorkspace for frontend authoring and DcpHostRuntime with createDcpRuntimeAdapter for host-bound v1 forms. The application supplies authenticated load, preview and save routes, scope identity and optional shared recovery scope. Revisions remain strings; collection rows use _id; omitted values retain data and null clears explicitly. Jira PLIBRYBEND-206 contains the verified backend handoff and remaining backend work. Advanced enterprise contracts and actual production/native acceptance are not yet complete.
messages.designer.guide.contract.controls: The examples include RadioGroup, RangeField and FormErrorSummary. RangeField combines a slider with numeric entry; disabling it disables both controls. Error summaries announce validation and can focus the matching field.
messages.designer.rowLimit: Add or remove rows to meet this section’s limits.
messages.designer.guide.contract.repeating: Select a section and enable Repeat this section to add a bounded group of rows. Set minimum and maximum rows. Each row retains its own identity, values and validation messages. Calculations run per row; changing a shared parent clears dependent selections in every row. Copying a sample remaps its internal field references. Designer repetition currently supports one row level; nested collections are available in the separate v1 runtime.
